subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread targeting be exposed as a new `dmThreadMode` key, folded into the existing `replyToMode` or broader thread-session work, or deferred?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing config surface and reopens behavior intentionally suppressed by a prior merged DM delivery fix, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API or proof bar.

options.title: Consolidate the threading API
options.body: Use one accepted Google Chat threading model, likely aligned with `replyToMode` or the broader thread-session work, then complete contracts and proof in that shape.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` separately
options.body: Keep this PR's separate DM-only knob, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs, and redacted live Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind broader thread work
options.body: Leave this branch open or close later only if a broader merged PR safely covers the same DM thread-targeting behavior.

recommendation.title: Consolidate the threading API
recommendation.body: Use one accepted Google Chat threading model, likely aligned with `replyToMode` or the broader thread-session work, then complete contracts and proof in that shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He verified and merged the prior DM thread-suppression fix and is the strongest available routing candidate for the Google Chat DM delivery/product choice.
